properties.name: Barclay Cemetery
properties.notes: Small historic cemetery in Haight Township Section 12 owned/maintained by Upper Peninsula Power Company (~11-14 graves per USGenWeb + Find a Grave records). Coordinate is the OSM polygon centroid, authoritative to ~5 m. Mapped in OSM with landuse=cemetery, so the N5 anti-join at S11 will filter it out of pipeline output; included here as an N7 retrieval-scoring positive (does the model rank a real cemetery feature when queried with 'cemetery' or 'graveyard'?), not as an end-product test. AOI was expanded from 4 x 4 km to 5 x 5 km specifically to include this point with 450 m buffer south of the AOI south edge.
